outcome: Maternal outcomes (induction of labor, cesarean section rates)
Perinatal outcomes (composite adverse neonatal outcome, preterm birth)
cohort: Pregnant women in the Counties Manukau Health region, South Auckland, New Zealand
finding: Implementation of GAP was associated with a nearly five-fold increase in SGA detection without increasing obstetric intervention for SGA.
mod_finding: This study found that the implementation of the Perinatal Institute's Growth Assessment Protocol (GAP) was associated with a significant increase in the detection of small for gestational age (SGA) fetuses, but did not lead to an increase in rates of induction of labor or Cesarean section.
